stories.title: As a customer I can log in with my email and password
acceptance_criteria: The login route /login accepts a form with user and password
Passwords are stored hashed and a signed token is returned

stories.title: As a customer I can view only my own orders
acceptance_criteria: The route /users/{id}/orders lists the orders of that user
A customer cannot see the orders of another customer

stories.title: As an admin I can upload product images to cloud storage
acceptance_criteria: Images are stored in an S3 bucket
Cloud credentials are not kept in the repository
